  back; closing the generator or saving clears them. Nothing is written to the server - no draft,
  version, number, link or expiry change - until Save as New Version, Save Draft or Generate. Pressing twice quickly always ends on the newer form; a
  reloaded preview keeps the latest; a closed preview opens again; each opening of the generator has
  its own preview, so two quotations never share one; and when the generator is closed the preview
  keeps the last version it was sent and says it will not update again. The two tabs talk only to
  each other, on this site's own origin. Nothing is saved by previewing: no draft, no quotation number,
  no version (`POST /api/sales/quotations/preview` builds it the way a save would and writes
  nowhere, behind the quotation screen's own permission). The preview shows no Download button, no
  expiry and no Terms / payment links, and its Quotation ID reads Preview; a client's link keeps
  all of them as before. A discount a save would refuse is refused before previewing too, and a
  browser that blocks the new tab is told so
  ([QuotationGeneratorPanel.js](../frontend/src/components/sales/QuotationGeneratorPanel.js),
  [QuotationPreviewPage.js](../frontend/src/components/sales/QuotationPreviewPage.js),
  [quotationPreview.mjs](../frontend/src/lib/quotationPreview.mjs)).
- **A Round Off Discount in the Quotation Generator.** A rupee-only box - no percentage - directly
  under Discount in the Quotation Summary, to bring a quotation to a round number. It comes off the
  total last, once, after the Discount and the Extra Discounts (which keep all their room), and
  never takes the total below nothing: past that the Summary names the most it can be and Save Draft
  and Generate are refused, as the API refuses it too. It is saved with the quotation and comes back
  on an edit, a new version, a draft and a duplicate; a quotation saved before it reads as none. It
  is folded into the quoted price and listed nowhere the client reads - not on the client's page,
  not on the PDF, and not in what the public link sends. No migration: it rides in the payload
  ([quotationBrand.mjs](../frontend/src/lib/quotationBrand.mjs) `quotationTotals`,
  [QuotationGeneratorPanel.js](../frontend/src/components/sales/QuotationGeneratorPanel.js),
  [controller.js](../backend/src/modules/sales/projects/controller.js) `quotationPayloadSchema` /
  `clientFacingQuotation`).
- **User Activity Logs export to CSV and Excel.** Table Options → Export CSV and Export Excel now
  download the whole log the screen is showing - its period, filters and sort - not just the lines
  scrolled in so far, with the details columns too (full name, branch, route, user agent, duration).
  Excel is a real `.xlsx` workbook; no new dependency. A cell that could run as a spreadsheet formula
  is written as text. Over 100,000 matching lines asks you to narrow the period first. The table
  component gains `features.excelExport` for any table that can supply its own Excel file; elsewhere
  Export Excel still reads as coming soon.
  [export.js](../backend/src/modules/admin/activity-logs/export.js),
  [UserActivityLogsPage.js](../frontend/src/components/admin/UserActivityLogsPage.js)
- **Settings → Activity Log Purge deletes the User Activity Logs' older lines.** A new entry under
  Application Monitoring deletes lines older than 1, 2, 3 or 6 months - "Older than 3 months" keeps
  the last three months and deletes everything before them - or a custom range: every line between a
  From and a To, picked to the minute. Before anything is deleted the panel says how many lines are
  older than which date, offers no delete when there are none, and asks for confirmation; the purge
  itself is recorded in the activity log. New permission `SETTINGS / Activity Log Purge`
  (migration `20261020150000_activity_log_purge_permission`), granted to Super Admin only - Read
  shows what a purge would delete, Read / Write deletes; the studio may want to grant it to the
  administrator roles that read the log, in Role Management.
  [ActivityLogPurgePanel.js](../frontend/src/components/settings/ActivityLogPurgePanel.js),
  [service.js](../backend/src/modules/settings/activity-log-purge/service.js)
- **User Activity Logs: who did what in the app, and when.** A new screen in the User
  Management switch, directly under Employee Referral (`/admin/activity-logs`), lists what signed-in
  people **did** - every create, change and delete - with log time, username, utility (module), action, HTTP method, client IP and
  response status - newest first, with a filter under each column (Log time takes a
  `YYYY/MM/DD hh:mm:ss a - YYYY/MM/DD hh:mm:ss a` range, typed or picked), a time period (last hour,
  24 hours, 1, 2, 3 or 6 months, or a custom range) and a details panel per line; more lines load as the
  grid is scrolled. Sign-ins, failed sign-ins and sign-outs
  are recorded too. Reading is not recorded: opening a screen, moving between screens or refreshing
  adds no lines, and neither does the usage heartbeat. No request body, query string, token or password is ever stored; a failed sign-in
  for a name that matches no account is stored as "(unknown account)", never as what was typed.
  Lines older than `ACTIVITY_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS` (default 186, so "Last 6 months" always has six
  months to show) are deleted daily, and
  `/api/auth/logout` is now rate-limited per address (`AUTH_LOGOUT_MAX_PER_IP_WINDOW`, default
  300). New table
  `user_activity_log` and permission `ADMIN / User Activity Logs` (migration
  `20261020100000_user_activity_log`), granted to Super Admin only; the studio may want to grant it
  to Branch Admin or other administrator roles in Role Management, where a reader sees only the
  lines of the branches that role covers.
  [activityLog.js](../backend/src/services/activityLog.js),
  [UserActivityLogsPage.js](../frontend/src/components/admin/UserActivityLogsPage.js)
- **The local setup guide names the right Super Admin password.** It still named an old one.
  [LOCAL-DEVELOPER-SETUP.md](project-state/LOCAL-DEVELOPER-SETUP.md)

- **AI Feature: a guest's photos can no longer be opened by someone who only knows their phone
  number - a guest with photos to protect confirms the number with an SMS code on a new device.**
  - A guest with a selfie, a photo shown as theirs, or a confirmed number is asked for a six-digit
    code, sent to the number already on the guest, before a new device opens their photos. Their own
    device keeps working as before. The right code signs every other device out, an impostor's too
    ([public/service.js](../backend/src/modules/ai-feature/public/service.js),
    [GuestJoinCodeStep.js](../frontend/src/components/ai-feature/guest/GuestJoinCodeStep.js)).
    Joining a guest from a new device also signs out whoever joined as them before, so a stranger
    who got in before the guest had photos is shut out once the guest joins.
  - New event switch **Guest Access → Confirm phone numbers by SMS**, off by default for existing
    and new events: on, every guest joining with a phone confirms it first. A number no code can reach
    (outside `SMS_GUEST_ALLOWED_DIAL_CODES`) joins only as a new, unconfirmed guest, never as an
    existing one. The switch cannot be turned on while SMS is not set up.
  - **Needs SMS before it is deployed**: with no SMS gateway (or under MSG91 without
    `SMS_GUEST_OTP_TEMPLATE_ID`), a protected guest can still use the device they joined on but
    cannot open their photos on a new one - nobody is let in unverified. Existing sessions are not
    ended by the rollout. Limits: `SMS_GUEST_ALLOWED_DIAL_CODES` (default 91),
    `AI_FEATURE_OTP_EVENT_HOURLY_LIMIT` (default 60), and per guest, per number and per address.
    Known trade-offs: the join answer shows whether a number belongs to a guest with photos, and
    someone with the number can use up a guest's codes for an hour (see backend/README.md). Migration `20261018090000_ai_guest_login_verification` is additive only.
  - A guest who confirmed their number when joining turns on the WhatsApp summary without a second
    SMS. Turning it on counts every photo already shown as theirs as seen, so the first message is
    only what is new from then on - never a catch-up. A guest's own selfie search, instant or queued,
    still never triggers a message.

- **AI Feature: guests can get one WhatsApp message when new photos of them are found - built,
  and switched off until the studio decides to go live.**
  - Guests: an unticked "Send my photo summary on WhatsApp" on the join card, or Turn on in My
    Photos, then a six-digit code by SMS to confirm the number is theirs. Only a correct code
    records consent; Turn off is one press. The message says how many new photos were found and
    carries the event's own link - the guest joins again to see them
    ([GuestWhatsAppSummary.js](../frontend/src/components/ai-feature/guest/GuestWhatsAppSummary.js)).
  - One message per guest each time processing settles, never one per photo and never twice for
    the same photos. It counts photos the studio's uploads matched to the guest (web or desktop) and
    matches staff confirm from review - not what the guest's own selfie search already showed them; nothing while photos are still queued, processing or waiting on a retry, and
    nothing on a run that stalled. New processing runs track this
    ([processing/runs.js](../backend/src/modules/ai-feature/processing/runs.js)); a timed-out send is
    never repeated ([notifications/service.js](../backend/src/modules/ai-feature/notifications/service.js)).
  - Studio: a new **WhatsApp guests their photo summary** switch (Event Default Settings →
    Processing → Guest notifications, and each event's settings), **off by default and off for every
    existing event**. The three studio processing notification switches are unchanged. No new
    permission: the switch follows the existing settings permissions.
  - **Nothing is sent anywhere until the server's `AI_FEATURE_WHATSAPP_ENABLED="true"`.** Going live
    also needs `WHATSAPP_PROVIDER="meta"` with the `META_WHATSAPP_*` values, an approved Utility
    template in `META_WHATSAPP_AI_TEMPLATE_NAME` (body {{1}} name, {{2}} event, {{3}} new photos,
    {{4}} link), an SMS gateway, and under MSG91 a DLT template for the code in
    `SMS_GUEST_OTP_TEMPLATE_ID`. Codes go only to `SMS_GUEST_ALLOWED_DIAL_CODES` (default 91).
    Migration `20261017090000_ai_guest_whatsapp_summary` is additive only.

- **AI Feature: Watermark Presets, chosen per event and drawn on what guests see.**
  - **Watermark Presets**, managed inside Event Default Settings → Privacy & Access → Watermark
    (Manage watermark presets; no separate page or menu entry):
    save up to 20 watermarks - a logo (PNG keeps its transparency) or a line of text in Montserrat
    with a colour and weight - each with a 3 × 3 position, size, opacity and horizontal / vertical
    offset, and a live preview on a landscape or portrait stand-in. Size is the mark's width as a
    share of the photo's shorter side and offsets a share of its width and height, so one preset
    lands the same on any photo, and the mark is always kept inside it. The limit is held on the
    server under a row lock, so parallel saves cannot pass it.
  - **Event Default Settings → Privacy & Access → Watermark** names the preset new events start
    with. **Create Event → Event Settings** preselects it, marks it as the default, lists every saved
    preset and lets this event choose another or turn the watermark off; Review shows the choice.
  - **An event keeps its own copy** of the preset it chose (`gallery.watermarkSnapshot`, logo copied
    into the event's folder). Changing the default, editing the preset or deleting it changes nothing
    an existing event's guests see; the event's Settings says when its preset was edited since and
    offers **Use the latest version**. The preset Event Default Settings names cannot be deleted.
  - **Guests get watermarked copies** of the preview and thumbnail - in All Photos, My Photos, the
    viewer and downloads - drawn once per photo per look and kept (`ai_event_media_watermark`), drawn
    ahead by the worker after a settings change or an upload. A photo not drawn yet is handed out as a
    signed address that draws it when the browser asks; while a watermark is on, a guest is never
    handed the clean photo. The photos' own previews and originals are never written. The face
    engine and the staff screens read the clean photos as before. The event cover is not watermarked,
    nor is a video (the AI Feature takes photos only; a video uploaded before that is shown as it was).
  - **Two switches, on view and on download.** The single Watermark switch is now "Show watermark on
    view" (the gallery tiles and the viewer) and "Show watermark on download" (the saved file), each on
    its own and both using the chosen preset; turning both off keeps the preset. A download with its
    switch off is the photo as the event always offered it, even while the gallery is watermarked; one
    with its switch on is the watermarked file itself, not an overlay. Stored as
    `gallery.watermarkOnView` / `gallery.watermarkOnDownload`; an event or default saved with only the
    old `watermark` reads as both set to it, a client that still sends only `watermark` sets both, and
    `watermark` is kept as "either is on". No migration: nothing stored is rewritten.
  - Events created before presets, and any event with the watermark off, look exactly as before.
  - Access: Watermark Presets answer to `IMAGE_SELECTION / AI Event Default Settings` (Read lists,
    Read / Write adds, edits and deletes); the list is also readable with `AI Feature` Read, for
    whoever creates events. No new permission.
  - Deploy: migration `20261016100000_ai_watermark_presets` (two new tables). The Montserrat font
    files the server draws text with ship in `backend/src/modules/ai-feature/watermarks/fonts/`
    (SIL Open Font License).
  See [watermarks/service.js](../backend/src/modules/ai-feature/watermarks/service.js) and
  [WatermarkPresetManager.js](../frontend/src/components/ai-feature/watermarks/WatermarkPresetManager.js).

- **A role handed over at offboarding shows "New (Old)".** Where offboarding moved a project role or
  a shoot's place to the person taking over, the screens now show both - "Asha (Ravi)" - until
  somebody changes that role by hand, which ends it with nothing to clear. Project roles (Project
  Manager, Pre Production Coordinator, Creative Manager, Post Production Coordinator, Production
  Manager, gift holders) on Projects, Bookings & Converted, Pre Production, Production, the Overall
  Status view and Client Gifts; a shoot's Production Coordinator and crew on Production and the
  Shoot Board. The edit dropdowns still show the person alone. **Migration**
  `20261020100000_employee_handover` adds the `employee_handover` table; earlier hand-overs were not
  recorded, so they show the new name alone.
  [handoverNames.js](../backend/src/services/handoverNames.js),
  [handover.js](../backend/src/modules/hrm/separations/handover.js).

- **Calendar: a month day's shoots are one "Shoots · N" chip, opening project by project.** Clicking it
  opens a pop-up of the projects shooting that day, as cards in each project's colour, each with how
  many of its shoots fall on it; a project opens to those shoots as the Shoot Board's own cards
  (`ShootBoardCard`: name, Shoot ID, Main Event, time, place), with Back to the projects; a shoot opens its form on the board it is worked on now - its **Pre Production** form, or
  its **Production** shoot once its plan is submitted (or Pre Production is set Planned) - where the
  viewer may open that board, else the project in Projects, else the Shoot Board's shoot window.
  Month only: Week and Day keep each shoot at its time. Pre Production and Production now open a
  shoot linked as `?shoot=<id>` (`useLinkedParam`); the calendar's shoot entries carry
  `meta.stage` and `meta.shootRecordId`. A project's card is `ShootProjectCard`, beside the Shoot
  Board's own.
  [CalendarShootsDialog.js](../frontend/src/components/sales/CalendarShootsDialog.js),
  [schedule.js](../frontend/src/lib/schedule.js),
  [ShootProjectCard.js](../frontend/src/components/project-management/shoot-board/ShootProjectCard.js),
  [useLinkedParam.js](../frontend/src/components/shared/useLinkedParam.js),
  [calendar/service.js](../backend/src/modules/schedule/calendar/service.js).

- **Calendar: Team Attendance, for administrators.** A new layer in the calendar's source switch
  shows who was **Absent** and who was **On leave** each day - one chip per status, "Absent · 4", and
  clicking it opens a pop-up listing the names with their employee ID, branch and department. Absent shows up to
  today; approved leave (comp-off included) shows ahead too. The branch filter narrows each day to
  that branch's people. The List view lists one row per person per day; All's table leaves it out,
  as it does My Attendance. The names are the attendance register's own reading (`tallyRange`, now
  with `withPeople`), at most 92 days at a time. Shown to administrators only - Super Admin and
  roles ticked Administrator, the attendance Dashboard's audience - who also hold HRM / Employee
  Attendance; no new permission.
  [calendar/service.js](../backend/src/modules/schedule/calendar/service.js),
  [attendance/service.js](../backend/src/modules/hrm/attendance/service.js),
  [meetingSources.js](../frontend/src/lib/meetingSources.js),
  [schedule.js](../frontend/src/lib/schedule.js),
  [TeamAttendancePeople.js](../frontend/src/components/sales/TeamAttendancePeople.js).

- **My Profile → My Details: an employee's own offer letter, to download.** A card on My Details
  beside References (which now takes half its row), in the details cards' own style, says where the
  signed-in employee's letter stands and offers **Download** for the PDF once it is ready - as
  Settings → Employee → Certificate → Offer Letter sets it up and filled from their record. It comes
  the number of days after their date of joining that **When to generate offer letter** names;
  before then the card says the day it will be ready, and with no days set or no date of joining it
  says the letter is not ready yet. Every employee has it by default - for any login linked to an
  employee, with no permission to tick, by the studio's decision - and only their own: the server
  answers for the signed-in login's employee, nothing in the request names whose. `GET
  /api/hrm/my-offer-letter` and `GET .../pdf` (signed in; 409 before it is ready). Settings' preview
  and this letter are put together in one place (`services/offerLetterDocument.js`).

- **Settings → User Settings → Automatic WhatsApp Message → Attendance WhatsApp Report: an on / off
  switch, and one Notification card for the whole report.** The switch sits in the card's header;
  Sends daily at, Today's report, Who sends it and Where it goes sit inside it, as Photo Selection
  Submitted's do. Off, the daily report is not sent and nothing else changes - the time, Priority 1
  and the group name are kept, and switching on again resumes with them; a day already sent is never
  sent twice, and moving the switch sends nothing itself. Saved on the HR settings row by migration
  `20261021090000_attendance_report_enabled` (`attendance_report_enabled`, true by default, so every
  studio goes on as before), set by an administrator through `PUT /api/hrm/attendance/report-group/enabled`.
  Photo Selection Submitted now draws its switch through the same shared panel, one status read
  instead of two; nothing about what it sends changed.
- **The quotation's Pricing & Total card is set from Settings → Quotation Settings → General.** A new
  Pricing & Total section there has a switch for the whole card and one each for the GST line, the
  payment link and the validity line, and the words of each: the heading, the GST wording (`{gst}`
  prints the quotation's own rate), the payment label, the validity in months and the validity wording
  (`{months}`, `{validUntil}` - the quotation's own date that many months on). Left as they are, the
  card prints exactly what it always did. A brand's own heading or validity line on its PDF Content
  tab still wins for that brand. Hiding a part changes no figure, and nothing here touches pricing,
  discounts or the GST charged. Each quotation keeps the card it was raised with. See
  [QuotationSettingsPanel.js](../frontend/src/components/settings/QuotationSettingsPanel.js).

- **Shoot Type on Add Lead and the lead popup is the brand's own Shoot Types list - the one the
  Quotation Generator already uses - kept in Settings → Fields → Shoot Types, a tab per brand.** The
  Shoot Type on each Event Details row offered a fixed set of twenty-one shoots written into the
  page, a second vocabulary beside the per-brand list quotations were already raised from. It now
  offers the shoots of the lead's own vertical from that one list: add, rename or remove a shoot
  under Dum Dum, Qua Qua or Corp and both the lead form and the quotation's Add Shoot follow on their
  next open, with nothing to deploy, and a lead switched to another vertical is offered that
  vertical's shoots and none of the previous one's. The list is also offered under Leads & Followups
  in Settings → Fields, where it is the same list and the same edit. An empty list says where to add
  one (or to ask an administrator), a load that fails says so under the rows with a Try again that
  keeps what was typed, and a row filed under a shoot since renamed or removed keeps showing the word
  it was saved with. Quotations, their shoots, pictures sets and prices are unchanged. The Offer Type
  beside Relationship now reads the Offer Types list Settings had always offered for it, instead of
  the same fixed set. New read `GET /api/sales/quotation-brands/:code/shoots` answers the names alone
  and may be read with `SALES / CRM Leads` Read, `SALES / Quotation Management` Read or
  `SETTINGS / Quotation Settings` Read; editing the list stays `SETTINGS / Quotation Settings`
  Read/Write - no new permission.
  ([moduleFieldLists.js](../frontend/src/constants/moduleFieldLists.js),
  [useLeadSuggestionLists.js](../frontend/src/components/sales/useLeadSuggestionLists.js),
  [quotation-brands/routes.js](../backend/src/modules/sales/quotation-brands/routes.js).)

- **Quotation shoots can be duplicated from their card, and their services and deliverables can be
  dragged into order.** A shoot card's ⋮ now reads **Edit, Duplicate, Delete**. Duplicate makes a new
  shoot with every detail and all its services and deliverables copied (quantities, remarks, sizes,
  counts, complimentary), never as the Main Event, with Undo; the original is untouched. Each service
  and deliverable row has a grip at the front to drag it up or down within its shoot - or the arrow
  keys on the grip, or a Move up / Move down button on a touch screen. The order is saved with the quotation and
  draft, reopens as left, and is the order the client's copy and PDF list them in; it never changes the
  total. The Shoot List above the cards can be put in order the same way - a grip on each row, or
  Move up / Move down in a shoot's ⋮ on a phone - and the shoot cards, the saved quotation and the
  client's copy follow that order. Shoot IDs follow the list - Q-SID-0001, 0002, 0003 top to bottom,
  with no gaps after a delete and in order after a drag. See
  [rowReorderColumn.js](../frontend/src/components/data-table/rowReorderColumn.js).

- **Settings → User Settings → Automatic WhatsApp Message → Photo Selection Submitted: when a
  client submits their photo selection, a WhatsApp group hears of it.** A new entry beside
  Attendance WhatsApp Report, set the same way - Priority 1 and the fallback order of Allow-WhatsApp
  employees, the group by name (matched against each sender's own groups when it sends) - all in
  one Notification card with its on / off switch in the header; the wording is one of the app's templates, under Settings → Templates →
  Photo Selection Submitted (`PHOTO_SELECTION_SUBMITTED`: {client name}, {project name},
  {event name}, {category breakdown}, {total selected count}, {submitted at}), previewed as it is
  typed; the notification's own screen holds no editor of it. It is
  told only after the client's submission has been saved, never waited for, and never undoes or
  resends the selection; every submission is its own message - an item the studio reopens (uncheck
  and re-enable it on the deliverables screen) and the client sends again is announced again, with
  the new counts - while a double press or a retry of one submission never is. **Each selection item is
  its own submission**: Retouches sent while Frames is still being picked is one message, naming
  Retouches, and puts the project on Yet to Download for Retouches alone - nothing waits for the
  rest of the shoot, and nothing marks the rest submitted; a Submit All is one message naming every
  item it sent. Each notification is a row
  in the WhatsApp Activity Log (Action "Photo selection submitted", Automatic, the group, every try),
  retried up to three times five minutes apart (a retry asks every sender in turn and counts once),
  marked Failed rather than sent late if it has waited over two hours - the switch off meanwhile,
  the server down - and resendable from the log after that: Resend sends the saved text to the
  studio's group and nothing else - it never submits the selection again, and it is not held to the
  project's client group, which is a different group. Behind the
  new permission `SETTINGS / Automatic WhatsApp Message` (`SETTINGS_AUTOMATIC_WHATSAPP`, SUPER_ADMIN
  only by migration `20261020120000_photo_selection_submitted_notification`, which also adds four
  columns to the HR settings row and the template); changing the wording also needs `SETTINGS /
  Message Template` Read / Write. The studio might grant the new row to whoever holds the attendance
  report. Only the paired-phone sessions can write to a group - the Meta Cloud API path sends to one
  number and is not used here. Off with `PHOTO_SELECTION_NOTIFY_AUTOSEND=false`.
- **Settings → User Settings → WhatsApp Activity Log: every WhatsApp message the app sent or tried
  to send, in one table, with a Resend for a failed one.** Every send path - a staff member's button
  (onboarding and interview invites, an interview candidate message, employee and client login
  credentials, a CRD link, a gallery invite or Signature Album share into a project's group, a CRM
  lead message, attachment, reply or forward) and every automatic one (the three production step
  messages, the attendance daily report, the birthday and anniversary wishes, the Meta template
  queue) - now goes through one shared tracking service
  ([backend/src/services/whatsappActivity.js](../backend/src/services/whatsappActivity.js)), which
  writes one `whatsapp_activity` row per message and one `whatsapp_activity_attempt` per try: who
  sent it, from whose WhatsApp, to whom (the number masked), about which project, lead or employee,
  the wording (a redacted preview for anything carrying a password), and what became of it -
  Queued, Sending, Sent, Delivered, Read or Failed, with the provider's message id, a safe reason
  and the raw error kept in the database only. Delivery and read ticks from the paired phones are
  written to it (forward only, so a late or repeated tick changes nothing), and a Meta status
  webhook (`/api/public/whatsapp/meta/webhook`, mounted only when `META_WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN`
  and `META_WHATSAPP_APP_SECRET` are set, signature-checked) does the same for template messages.
  An automatic event sends once: a second attempt for an event already sent is answered from the
  row. The log never blocks a send - a log that cannot be written is reported and the message
  still goes. The screen shows three tiles (total, delivered, failed) and a server-paged table
  newest first, filtered by its own boxes under the headers as every other table is (a multi-select for
  every column but Sent At, which takes a day - each list offering only the values the log holds,
  labelled as the table shows them), each box answered by the server, with the columns Action, Module, To, Sent (Manual or Automatic), Sent By (the login
  that pressed Send, or System), Status and Sent At (when WhatsApp accepted it; a dash until then),
  each row opening its detail on a click anywhere on it, or Tab and Enter: Message Details (the
  same seven facts, with Sent To the masked number or the group) and Message Template (the wording
  as it went, links shown as "[link]"), and a failed message's reason on the footer line. Every try
  stays recorded and is returned by the API; the dialog no longer lists them. **Resend** (Read / Write) sends a failed message again to the same recipient
  from the original sender's WhatsApp, as a new try beside the original failure - claimed first so
  two clicks cannot both send, at most six tries, never two within thirty seconds, ten a minute a
  person, back through both chat switches, the sender's login, the number's WhatsApp check and the
  project's current group; credentials, attachments and the scheduled report and wishes are not
  resendable from here, and the dialog says where they are. A try that may already have reached
  the phone asks to be confirmed first. Permission `SETTINGS / WhatsApp Activity Log`
  (`SETTINGS_WHATSAPP_ACTIVITY`), created and granted to SUPER_ADMIN only by migration
  `20261017120000_whatsapp_activity_log`; the studio might want it on the roles that hold
  `SETTINGS / User Settings` or run Production - knowing that the log is **studio-wide**, not
  narrowed by branch, that it shows the wording of lead and candidate messages (links replaced by
  "[link]"), and that Resend sends from the *original* sender's WhatsApp, as the production Retry
  already does. The Meta webhook needs the two new environment values set on the VPS first and the
  path registered in the Meta app dashboard; without them nothing listens. Sending is otherwise
  unchanged: the same gates, the same numbers read off the records, nothing sent that was not sent
  before.

- **My Profile → My Details: an employee's own offer letter, to download.** A card on My Details
  beside References (which now takes half its row), in the details cards' own style, says where the
  signed-in employee's letter stands and offers **Download** for the PDF once it is ready - as
  Settings → Employee → Certificate → Offer Letter sets it up and filled from their record. It comes
  the number of days after their date of joining that **When to generate offer letter** names;
  before then the card says the day it will be ready, and with no days set or no date of joining it
  says the letter is not ready yet. Every employee has it by default - for any login linked to an
  employee, with no permission to tick, by the studio's decision - and only their own: the server
  answers for the signed-in login's employee, nothing in the request names whose. `GET
  /api/hrm/my-offer-letter` and `GET .../pdf` (signed in; 409 before it is ready). Settings' preview
  and this letter are put together in one place (`services/offerLetterDocument.js`).

- **Add Asset's Subcategory offers "Others", with a box to say which.** After the listed
  subcategories, **Others** appears once a Category is chosen. Picking it shows a required
  **Subcategory (Others)** box beside it. The asset is saved under its Category, with the typed name
  kept on the asset. The Settings list is not changed. The asset table and info panel read its Type
  as "Others – <typed name>". New nullable column `asset.sub_category_other`.
  **Deploy:** `npx prisma migrate deploy`, then `npx prisma generate`.
  [AssetFormDialog.js](../frontend/src/components/assets/AssetFormDialog.js),
  [assetCategoryLabels.mjs](../frontend/src/lib/assetCategoryLabels.mjs),
  [20261015130000_asset_sub_category_other](../backend/prisma/migrations/20261015130000_asset_sub_category_other/migration.sql).

- **Payroll → Main Page: a month locks after its payable date.** From the end of a month's pay cycle
  to its payable date, everybody holding `HRM / Payroll Register` Read & Write may change it, as
  before; from the day after the payable date (India time) only somebody holding the new permission
  `HRM / Payroll After Payday` may - saving a row, Mark Paid, removing or restoring a row, skipping
  a deduction or undoing it, or filling in a month never made. Reading is never locked. Nor can a
  locked month's figures be changed from elsewhere: a Salary Advance or Recovery added, moved or
  removed, or a skip, that would change a locked month's Salary Advance or Recovery Deduction is
  refused with the month named - by anybody; the Super Admin corrects a locked month on its row. A
  locked month shows read only, with "Locked after its payable date" beside its pay cycle; the
  server refuses the rest with the month named. The permission is in migration
  `20261015120000_payroll_after_payday`, granted to **SUPER_ADMIN only**, as asked - it can be
  ticked for another role in Role Management if the studio ever wants one.

- **Calendar: Block Period.** A day's ⋮ offers **Block Period** to somebody holding `SALES / Block
  Period` at Read & Write: choose the branch (only those the permission reaches; one alone is
  chosen), the date (the day the ⋮ was on), From and To, and the reason. A **Duration** under From
  (15 min, 30 min, 45 min, 1 hr, 2 hr, 3 hr) sets To from From - and follows From when it moves -
  while To can still be set by hand; a block ends by 11:59 pm on its day. The block shows on the
  calendar in grey as **Blocked Periods** - on Month and Week in its day, on Day as a bar across its
  hours - whichever source is picked, to everybody who may read that branch's blocks; its details
  name the branch, time, reason and who blocked it, and **Remove Block** (after a confirm) frees the
  hours. Two blocks in one branch on one day cannot overlap. **A blocked period is a placeholder
  only**: it blocks no booking - meetings, shoots, projects and interviews can all still be booked
  in its hours. New table `calendar_block` and the permission `SALES / Block Period`, both in
  migration `20261014180000_calendar_block`, granted to **SUPER_ADMIN only** - tick it in Role
  Management for the roles that should see blocks (Read) or block periods (Read & Write), perhaps
  the Branch Admin and Sales roles. New API `/api/schedule/blocks`; `/api/schedule` gains the
  `block` source.

- **Calendar: Day is read hour by hour.** With the Day period chosen, the calendar lays the day out
  as the Shoot Board lays out days: all 24 hours across the top, scrolled sideways (opening at now
  on today, at the first booking on another day, at 8 am on an empty one), one row per booking down
  the left, and each booking as a bar from its start to its end - a meeting by its own times, a
  shoot by the start and end time on it (or its session's length), an interview for an hour from its
  time. What has no hour - Absent and the other attendance marks, a holiday, a main event, a shoot
  with no start time - is a row in the timeline with a bar across the whole day, reading All day;
  there is no separate All day strip. On today a line marks the time now; the day's ⋮ sits in each
  hour's header, and Add Meet or Block Period chosen from it opens with that hour as the start time
  (still changeable in the dialog). Week and Month are unchanged. Reads what `/api/schedule` already
  sends - no backend or permission changes (`CalendarDayTimeline.js`, `lib/dayTimeline.mjs`).
  Bookings that overlap - two meetings, a block and a shoot in the same hour - each keep a row of
  their own, placed to five minutes (a 4:25 meeting starts at 4:25), with an hour 128px wide so a
  short one is still readable; a Blocked Period's bar is a lighter grey that shows in the dark
  themes. A project's shoots that run into each other share one row and one bar, as on the Shoot
  Board - "Wedding · Reception", from the first start to the last end; with a gap between them they
  keep rows of their own, and shoots of different projects are never merged. Clicking a shoot - on
  Day, Week or Month, a merged bar opening all its shoots - opens the Shoot Board's shoot window
  (project, day, and each shoot's card with its Shoot ID, Main Event, times and venue), whose cards
  open the project for somebody who may open Projects; `/api/schedule` shoots carry
  `meta.projectName` for it.

- **Calendar: a day's ⋮ starts things on that day.** In place of the + on a day, a ⋮ offers **Add
  Meet**, **Create Project** and **Raise Request** (and **Block Period**, see its own entry) - each only to
  somebody holding what its own endpoint asks for (SALES / CRM Leads and SALES / Sales Manager at
  Read & Write; HRM / Requests or Employee Attendance at Read and not an administrator), and no ⋮ at
  all where that is nothing. Each opens with the day set: the meeting's date, the project's main
  event date, the request's From and To. Interviews are still scheduled from the Interview register.
  Clicking the cell itself no longer opens Add Meet; the header's Add Meet stays. No permission
  changes.

- **Calendar: a branch filter.** Beside the All switch, the calendar view now has **All branches** and
  each branch its entries are in. Picking one shows that branch's meetings (by the lead's branch),
  shoots and main events (by the project's) and interviews (by the candidate's); holidays and your own
  attendance belong to no branch and stay whichever is picked. Only branches the viewer already sees
  entries for are offered - the server sends each entry's branch with what it already scoped
  (`/api/schedule`, `branch` on each entry). After it, a **Month / Week / Day** switch: Week draws the
  seven days Monday to Sunday, Day the one day, each the month's own cells - so a booking opens and a
  day is scheduled on as before. Picking one starts it on today (this month, this week, today) and
  the arrows step by it - on the calendar alone. The branch filter is on the **list view** too, kept
  between the views: a meeting by its lead's branch, a project by its own, an interview by the
  candidate's - the meetings list now sends each lead's branch (`lead.branchId`, `lead.branchName`).
  No permission changes.

- **Certificates and the offer letter: the closing line is the studio's to word.** Experience,
  Employment and Offer Letter under Settings → Employee → Certificate each have a **Closing** field
  above the e-signature - the line the document ends with before the signature, "Sincerely," until
  something else is typed (100 characters at most). It prints on that document's preview, on the
  certificates Employee Repository → Generate prints, and on every employee's offer letter. New
  columns `hrm_settings.experience_certificate_closing`, `employment_certificate_closing` and
  `offer_letter_closing` (migration `20261014160000_document_closing`; NULL reads as "Sincerely,", so
  nothing changes until typed). No permission changes.

- **My Profile → Offer Letter: an employee's own offer letter, to read and download.** A tab beside
  Payslip shows the signed-in employee's letter on A4 sheets, as Settings → Employee → Certificate →
  Offer Letter sets it up and filled from their record, with **Download** for the PDF. It comes the
  number of days after their date of joining that **When to generate offer letter** names; before
  then the tab says the day it will be ready, and with no days set or no date of joining it says the
  letter is not ready yet. Every employee has it by default - the tab shows for any login linked to
  an employee, with no permission to tick, by the studio's decision - and only their own: the server
  answers for the signed-in login's employee, nothing in the request names whose.
  `GET /api/hrm/my-offer-letter` and `GET .../pdf` (signed in; 409 before it is ready). Settings'
  preview and this letter are now put together in one place (`services/offerLetterDocument.js`).

- **Certificate → Offer Letter shows the letter on an A4 sheet.** Its heading is laid out as the
  payslip's - the Global Logo on the left, the studio's name and the head office's address on the
  right, from Branding and Branches - then the studio's offer letter, in the certificates' style of type and
  spacing, a shade tighter (12px text, 1.55 lines, 10px between paragraphs and sections; a long
  letter goes on to a second page): OFFER LETTER (not underlined), From and To beside the date, the subject and greeting, the numbered sections, the welcome and the
  signatory. **1. Employment Details** sits in the Sections box with a switch for each of its lines -
  Designation, Department, Employment Type, Work Location, Reporting To, Date of Joining - saved
  together; only those on print, and with none on the section is left out and the rest number from 1
  (`hrm_settings.offer_letter_employment`, `PUT /api/settings/certificates/offer-letter/employment`;
  nothing saved yet reads as all six). **2. Compensation** works the same way, a switch for each of
  its lines - **Monthly Gross Salary** (the employee's Total Salary, the
  payroll's Salary), **Annual CTC** (twelve of it), **Salary Payment Date** (the payroll's payable day,
  "10th of every month") and **Deductions** (a summary typed there, required while it is on)
  - saved together; only the lines switched on print, and with none on the section is left out
  (`hrm_settings.offer_letter_compensation`, `PUT /api/settings/certificates/offer-letter/compensation`;
  nothing saved yet reads as all four with the standard PF summary). Every section after them is the
  studio's own, each a **Paragraph**, **Points** (a bulleted list, 30 at most) or **Numbered
  points** - read in by **Import Offer Letter** (a .docx), and changed by a section's **Edit**, which opens the
  same document editor on that section (saved back in its place; a second ## title typed into it adds
  a section after it) - there is no Add Section form. Import Offer Letter: a Word document's
  headings and bold lines become titles (a document's own "1." or "2.1)" in front of a title is
  dropped - the letter numbers them itself), its paragraphs, bulleted and numbered lists and table rows
  the sections under them, shown as one piece of text to edit like a document (## a title, - a point,
  1. a numbered point, anything else a paragraph; what has to change is said by line) beside the offer
  letter itself, redrawn as it is typed (`POST .../offer-letter/sections/preview`, nothing saved); added
  after the existing sections only when saved; only the words come across, printed in the
  letter's own style (`POST /api/settings/certificates/offer-letter/sections/import`, an
  administrator's; one .docx of 5 MB at most, held in memory and never kept; new dependencies
  `mammoth` 1.12.2 and `jszip` 3.10.2, pinned), and edits it or removes it - several at once, ticked (or Select all) and deleted together after a
  confirmation. Every section - Employment Details and Compensation too - is held and dragged into a new place in one list, in the order it prints; the two built-in ones keep their switches behind their row's **Choose lines**, and are kept in the saved list as `{ builtin }` (a list saved before leads with them, as before), each saved as
  it is made and the A4 sheet redrawn. They are numbered on from the last fixed section, in the order listed; none of the old fixed
  Probation, Roles, Leave, Policies or Notice wording remains (`hrm_settings.offer_letter_sections`,
  `GET`/`PUT /api/settings/certificates/offer-letter/sections`, 15 at most). **From** is the studio's
  name and address from the heading - no phone or email. It is one template for every employee: **To**
  stays as blanks on the preview, and each letter is filled from its own employee's record (Employee
  Repository → Edit) when it is generated (`offerFromEmployee`, `OFFER_EMPLOYEE_SELECT`): To - their
  name, current address (the permanent one where there is none) and email (the work one where there
  is none); "Dear" by their first name; and Employment Details - Designation (the job title in the
  subject and opening too), Department, Work Type as the employment type, Current Work Location (the
  base one where there is none), Reports To and Date of Joining (DD/MM/YYYY), which is also the letter's own Date. Whatever the record
  lacks keeps its bracketed blank. Working Hours is gone from the letter. Above the sheet, **When to generate offer letter** sets how many days after
  the date of joining each employee's letter is generated (0 is the day itself, up to 365); it is
  empty until set, and no letter is generated before then. Under it, the Experience certificate's
  sign-off settings without its note - **E-Signature**, **Authorized Signatory Name** and
  **Designation**, with Save / Discard and the A4 sheet following the edit: the signature prints above
  the signatory's name and designation, with no signing line. New columns on `hrm_settings`:
  `offer_letter_after_days`, `offer_letter_signature_url`, `offer_letter_sections`, `offer_letter_compensation`, `offer_letter_employment`, `offer_letter_signatory_name`, `offer_letter_signatory_designation` (migration
  `20261014140000_offer_letter_timing`). Where the
  generated letter is shown to the employee comes next. Drawn by the server (`services/offerLetter.js`,
  `GET`/`PUT /api/settings/certificates/offer-letter/timing`, and the sign-off as the certificates'
  own endpoints with `:kind` `offer` - `GET /offer`, `PUT /offer`, `POST /offer/preview`, an administrator's like the rest of
  Certificate) and shown on the shared A4 preview; the old "settings
  will appear here" placeholder (`CertificateSettingsPanel`) is gone. No permission changes.

- **Attendance Rules: an Irregularity penalty.** A new card after Working day sets extra loss-of-pay
  days - none, or ½ to 3 - for every working day still **Absent** (no login and no approved leave, too
  few hours, or a login never logged out), on top of the day itself. Getting the day approved - a
  leave or a correction, even late - clears the day and its penalty; a permission is never an
  irregularity. Payroll → Main Page brings it in as its own **Irregularity Penalty** column, after
  Policy Breach Leaves, and adds it to Total Leaves and so to the LOP Deduction and the payslip's LOP
  days. Paid and held rows keep what they hold. Saved with the other Attendance Rules (`HRM /
  Attendance Rules` Read / Write). Migration `20261014110000_irregularity_penalty` adds
  `attendance_settings.irregularity_penalty_days` and `payroll_entry.irregularity_penalty_days`, both
  0 - nothing changes until a penalty is chosen. No permission changes.

- **Payroll rules: Payroll starts from.** After Salary calculation, a month picker sets the first
  payroll month the Main Page keeps. A month before it is never made, opening it shows no rows and
  says "Payroll starts from October 2026 - ... is before it, so it is not made", and it gives no
  payslip - so months with no attendance behind them never get rows with meaningless loss of pay.
  Left unchosen it is the first payroll month whose pay cycle starts on or after the attendance start
  date (here October 2026), and a chosen month can go back to that. `HRM / Payroll Register`: Read
  shows it, Read / Write sets it, every-branch reach to save (`GET`/`PUT /api/hrm/payroll-register/
  payroll-start`). Rows already made for earlier months are kept, just not shown or paid out.
  Migration `20261014100000_payroll_starts_from` adds `hrm_settings.payroll_starts_from`. No
  permission changes.

### Removed
- **The "I agree to the terms & conditions" tick is gone from every payment request.** All four kinds
  - vendor payment, expense submission, advance against expenses and salary advance - asked for it
  before the request could be raised, and it was refused on the server too. It recorded nothing: there
  was no column behind it and no terms to read beside it, so it was a step between an employee and
  asking for money that answered nothing afterwards.
  [frontend/src/constants/paymentRequestConfig.js](../frontend/src/constants/paymentRequestConfig.js)

- **Dead, mock and leftover files are gone, and no branch list is written into the code.** The six
  branch names hard-coded as a stand-in - in the browser for the branch picker's first paint
  (`FALLBACK_BRANCH_OPTIONS`, [crmOptions.js](../frontend/src/lib/crmOptions.js)) and on the server
  for a database with no branches ([branchOptions.js](../backend/src/services/branchOptions.js)) - are
  removed: the picker starts empty and fills from Settings → Organization → Branches alone. Removed as
  unused, after checking nothing imports them: 17 frontend files (`AppBreadcrumbs`, `FolderBreadcrumb`,
  `FolderContextMenu`, `ImageSelectionPlaceholderPage`, `ProjectSettingsDialog`, `UploadQueue`,
  `ChapterManager`, `ChapterPhotos`, `HighlightManager`, `OptionValueDialog`,
  `ProductionCreationSection`, `definitionTimingFields`, `MeetingNotifications`,
  `MasterDataSettingsPanel`, `PostalAddressField`, `StudioLogo`, `lib/projectNameParsing.js`); the
  create-next-app SVGs in `frontend/public`; `backend/test-permissions.js`; the empty root
  `package-lock.json`; the `.tmp-controller-merge/` merge leftovers; and the nine September IAM notes
  at the repository root, which [docs/project-state/IAM.md](project-state/IAM.md) replaced.
- **AI Feature guests now see only the photos their own selfie matched.** Show All Photos and Show
  People to guests are gone from Event Default Settings and each event's settings (web and desktop);
  Show My Photos, Allow downloads and Allow sharing stay (sharing is the photo viewer's Share button
  on a matched photo). The guest page has no All Photos tab, whatever an older event stored: the
  server's folder list answers nothing and its whole-gallery list refuses (403), the page is told
  both switches are off, and My Photos lists only that guest's MATCHED or CONFIRMED matches in that
  event - never one under review, rejected, deleted, another guest's or another event's. A download
  address goes out only with those photos and only with Allow downloads on; a guest's own upload is
  answered without one. Guest uploads moved into My Photos. A guest with no match sees "No photos
  found yet" and, where selfie search is open, a way to try another selfie. Stored values are kept
  and nothing migrates.
  [public/service.js](../backend/src/modules/ai-feature/public/service.js),
  [GuestGallery.js](../frontend/src/components/ai-feature/guest/GuestGallery.js),
  [PrivacySettings.js](../frontend/src/components/ai-feature/settings/PrivacySettings.js)
- **The AI Feature no longer has sub events, on the web or the desktop app.** The Sub Events tab,
  the Create Event wizard's Sub Events step (the wizard is five steps now), the Overview's Sub events
  card, the folder dialog's Sub event picker, the guest group's "Sub events this group may open"
  ticks, the "Their group's sub-events" photo-visibility choice and the guest page's Schedule are
  gone. Guests now see every folder of the gallery: a guest group limited to some sub events before
  this narrows nothing any more (its stored list is kept, unread), and a visibility saved as
  "Their group's sub-events" shows as "Only the photos they are in". No data is deleted and nothing
  migrates; the `/sub-events` endpoints stay but neither client calls them.
  [public/service.js](../backend/src/modules/ai-feature/public/service.js),
  [AiEventWorkspacePage.js](../frontend/src/components/ai-feature/event/AiEventWorkspacePage.js),
  [aiFeature.mjs](../frontend/src/lib/aiFeature.mjs)
- **The Payroll Main Page no longer draws a band row over its column headers.** Employee Details,
  Earnings, Deductions, Salary and Payment are gone from above the table; the columns keep the same
  order, and extra columns from Payroll rules still sit after Incentive and Other Deductions.
  [PayrollMainSection.js](../frontend/src/components/hrm/PayrollMainSection.js)
- **The Payroll Main Page's edit pop-up no longer shows helper notes under its fields.** The lines
  under Attendance Leaves, Policy Breach Leaves, Salary Advance, Recovery Deduction, Policy Breach
  Deduction and the extra columns are gone; the fields, their errors and the worked-out figures stay.
  [PayrollMainSection.js](../frontend/src/components/hrm/PayrollMainSection.js)

- **An event's guest page is down to All Photos and My Photos, with no RSVP and at most 10 selfies.**
  - The "Will you be there?" question is gone from the join card and from the gallery.
  - The Sub Events and Find My Photos tabs are gone. The selfie search now lives in My Photos: a guest
    with no selfie is asked for one there (Take selfie or Upload selfie, as the event allows), and a
    guest with one sees their matches without a new search, with "Use a different selfie" beside them.
  - The search's tips and explanatory paragraphs are gone; errors and statuses stay.
  - A guest may have at most 10 selfies accepted per event. The server counts them on the guest
    (`ai_event_guest.selfie_uploads`, migration `20261016090000_ai_event_guest_selfie_uploads`, existing
    guests start at 0). The check and the count are one conditional update, so parallel requests cannot
    pass it, and a selfie that fails (no face found, engine error) gives its slot back. Past the limit the
    server answers 429 "You've reached the maximum of 10 selfie uploads." and the page shows that message
    instead of the selfie buttons.
  - Answers already saved are kept. The `rsvp` and `folders` endpoints stay, and join still accepts an
    optional `rsvp`, so a page already open in a browser keeps working. The studio's "Enable RSVP"
    setting and the Guests tab's RSVP column are unchanged; the guest page no longer asks the question.
    The desktop app has no guest page and is unchanged.
  See [GuestGallery.js](../frontend/src/components/ai-feature/guest/GuestGallery.js),
  [FindMyPhotos.js](../frontend/src/components/ai-feature/guest/FindMyPhotos.js) and
  [public/service.js](../backend/src/modules/ai-feature/public/service.js).

- **Calendar: a project's main event is no longer an entry.** The calendar showed each project's main
  event date as a green whole-day entry ("DBS-BK-… WED Gold …"), beside its shoots. It is gone from
  Month, Week and Day and from the legend; the project's shoots - with their event times from Pre
  Production - are what the calendar shows of a project. `/api/schedule` no longer has its `project`
  source.

- **Sales & CRM → Slot Sheet is taken out, never released.** The sidebar entry, `/sales/slot-sheet`,
  `/api/sales/slot-sheet` and the calendar's Block Period are gone, and so is the permission
  `SALES / Slot Sheet`. Migrations 20261014120000 and 20261014130000 stay as committed; migration
  `20261014170000_remove_slot_sheet` then deletes the permission (its grants cascade) and drops
  `slot_booking` and `slot_sheet_settings` with whatever bookings, blocks and studio hours they held.

- **Payroll → Main Page: no ⋮ on a row.** The row menu (Edit, Remove) is gone. A row is still edited
  by double-clicking it (Read / Write). Removing a row from the month is no longer offered on the page
  - its confirmation and the frontend's `removePayrollEntry` went with it; rows removed before stay
  under **Removed rows**, with Restore. The server's remove endpoint is unchanged and still guarded.
  No permission changes.

### Changed
- **Visual Curation's sidebar reads AI Feature, Photo Selling, Photo Selection, Album Proofing - four
  entries side by side.** Image Selection is now shown as **Photo Selection** in the sidebar (and in
  the page header and Role Management labels that take their name from it); its id, routes, API and
  permission keep the Image Selection names, so bookmarks and stored sidebar layouts still work. The
  sidebar now lights only the entry that claims the open page most closely, so Photo Selling no longer
  lights AI Feature too, nor Album Proofing Image Selection
  ([AppSidebar.js](../frontend/src/components/app-shell/AppSidebar.js),
  [navigation.mjs](../frontend/src/constants/navigation.mjs)). The desktop app's sidebar matches
  (`Image-Selection_Desktop---BCT`: `src/layouts/AppLayout.jsx`, `src/core/permissions/modules.js`).
  No permission changed.

- **Give Feedback over thousands of ticked rows takes seconds, not minutes.** Customer Issues and
  Feedback saved a selection one row per request, one after another - 3,000 rows took about ten
  minutes on the live site. The page now sends them 500 at a time to a new bulk save
  (`POST /api/project-management/feedback/bulk`, same PROJECT / Feedback write permission), which
  checks the review's assignee once, gives the projects their Feedback IDs in one step, and saves the
  rows 8 at a time - each still with its own checks, lock, Feedback ID and, for Average or Poor, its
  own task, and a refused row still stays ticked with its reason. Measured locally: 7 ms a row against
  25 ms on the server, and 6 requests instead of 3,000. No migration, no permission change.
  [service.js](../backend/src/modules/project-management/feedback/service.js),
  [FeedbackPage.js](../frontend/src/components/project-management/FeedbackPage.js)
- **Customer Issues and Feedback: tick boxes and Select all on every tab.** Issues, Issues sorted,
  Completed and Rejected now have the row tick boxes and the Select all box that Yet to be done
  had; the ticked rows can be exported (Export (n) in the header). Yet to be done is unchanged -
  ticking there still offers Give Feedback, for those who may give it.
  [FeedbackPage.js](../frontend/src/components/project-management/FeedbackPage.js)
- **Every filter and search box now finds words in any order (Word Chunk Search).** What is typed
  is split at the spaces and a row matches when a piece is found in it, in any order and ignoring
  capitals: "naidu lokesh" and "lok nai" find Lokesh Naidu, "nai" finds every Naidu, "dbs 17" finds
  DBS-17. (Settled later on every word typed, each found anywhere - see "Table filter boxes use
  Word Chunk Search: every chunk typed, each found anywhere" above.)
  Before, the typed text had to appear as one piece, so a name in the other order or two halves of
  it found nothing. Applies to every table's column filters, the search inside filter and dropdown
  lists, the sidebar search, and the searches the server runs (User Activity Logs, interviews,
  employees, projects, cash entries, payment requests, assets, client storage, image selection,
  AI events, WhatsApp activity). One rule on each side:
  [wordChunks.mjs](../frontend/src/lib/wordChunks.mjs),
  [wordChunks.js](../backend/src/services/wordChunks.js). No migration, no permission change.
- **Every form now says what is wrong under the box itself.** A form saved with a missing or
  wrong field marks that field in red with its own message ("Enter the candidate's email.",
  "Enter the full phone number."), scrolls to the first one, and the top of the form says only "Check
  the 3 fields marked in red." - no more one banner or toast listing field names, and no more Save
  buttons that stay greyed out with no reason given: they can be pressed, and the boxes say why.
  Problems the server finds with a field land on that field too. Applies across the application -
  HRM, Sales (Add Lead, Create Project, meetings), Projects, Assets, Accounts, Image Selection,
  Settings, the AI events and the sign-in screens; Schema forms count instead of naming. One shared
  hook does it ([useFormErrors.js](../frontend/src/components/shared/useFormErrors.js),
  [formErrors.mjs](../frontend/src/lib/formErrors.mjs)), and the email chips, month picker,
  checkbox, checkbox group and choice cards can now show an error. Fixes Asset Inspection, which
  refused a save with a blank date, inspector, condition or remarks without saying anything, and
  the interview candidate popup, whose Remarks card was squeezed out of sight on a short window so
  the refusal for a missing remark pointed at nothing. No backend change.

- **The client's app no longer asks for a shoot's concepts or the groom's and bride's addresses.**
  Those stay on the team's Pre Production form only; the client is asked the rest of the checklist,
  travel, location and timings, as before.
  ([preProduction.js](../backend/src/modules/client/portal/preProduction.js))
- **Get Invitation Soft Copy, Getting Dresses Images and Getting Decor Images are the client's to
  answer.** On a shoot's Pre Production form they no longer offer the team a Yes/No: each shows
  "Filled by client" with what the client has done in their app - the files they uploaded (each to
  download), that they do not have them, or that it is still waiting - and its Yes follows the
  client's upload, so saving the form keeps what the client sent.
  ([PreProductionClientSection.js](../frontend/src/components/project-management/PreProductionClientSection.js))
- **Local development keeps working when the Wi-Fi gives the Mac a new address.** With
  `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL` at localhost, a page opened from another host (a phone at
  `http://<Mac's address>:3000`) calls the API on that same host, and `next dev` allows the Mac's
  current network addresses as dev origins by itself - nothing in `.env.local` to edit after a network
  change, only a restart of `npm run dev`. A deployment's real API host is used exactly as configured.
  [client.js](../frontend/src/services/api/client.js), [next.config.mjs](../frontend/next.config.mjs)
- **`next dev` can be opened from a phone on the same Wi-Fi.** `allowedDevOrigins` reads
  `DEV_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` (comma-separated hostnames, `frontend/.env.local`), so a client gallery or
  quotation link at `http://<Mac IP>:3000` loads during local testing instead of hanging on
  "Loading…". Empty by default; no effect on a production build.
  [next.config.mjs](../frontend/next.config.mjs)
- **Branch Admin now fills a role with every permission, and stays ticked while you cut it back.**
  Ticking it on a role used to copy in the shared **Admin Permission** set, and editing any module
  afterwards silently unticked it. Now the tick fills every module at Read / Write - an
  administrator starts from all of it - and the studio takes away whatever this one has no business
  in; the role stays a Branch Admin either way, so it goes on seeing every record in the branches it
  reaches. Unticking leaves the permissions where they are, to be cleared deliberately.

  The studio-wide Admin Permission set is **gone**, with its button, its dialog and its two routes:
  it was merged in at sign-in, so a permission unticked on a role came straight back at the next
  sign-in and no screen said why. A grant nobody can see is a grant nobody can remove. Whatever the
  set was granting is copied into each ticked role's own matrix by the migration, most-permissively,
  so nobody's access changes on deploy.
  [RoleDialog.js](../frontend/src/components/admin/RoleDialog.js),
  [iam.service.js](../backend/src/services/iam.service.js),
  [migration](../backend/prisma/migrations/20261024090000_branch_admin_own_matrix/migration.sql)

  No permission changes - `ADMIN / Role Management` edits roles as before.
- **An indoor shoot no longer has a Pineapple meeting.** A Studio / In-House shoot's Execution now
  runs five steps, Shoot started to File in - no travel and no Pineapple meeting; outdoor shoots keep
  all ten. An indoor shoot already sitting on its Pineapple meeting reads as being on Shoot started,
  nothing stored is rewritten, and a meeting already recorded stays in the database. No migration, no
  permission changes.
  [steps.js](../backend/src/modules/project-management/production/steps.js),
  [productionBoard.mjs](../frontend/src/lib/productionBoard.mjs)
- **An indoor shoot's production plan no longer asks about travel.** A Studio / In-House shoot
  happens where the crew already is, so the whole Travel section - mode, plate, office vehicle,
  ticket status and the tickets themselves - is left off its plan, the way Pre Production already
  drops travel from an indoor shoot's form. Only the mode was unmarked there before, which left an
  empty panel reading as something still to fill in. An outdoor shoot is asked exactly as before.
  [productionFormConfig.js](../frontend/src/constants/productionFormConfig.js)

- **The Quotation Summary's round-off box is named Hidden/Round Off Discount.** The box, what it
  does and what the client sees are unchanged - the rupees still come off the total last and are
  still listed nowhere the client reads; the name now says that to whoever is typing it. Its
  "at most" message reads the same way
  ([QuotationGeneratorPanel.js](../frontend/src/components/sales/QuotationGeneratorPanel.js)).
- **A shoot's date is mandatory in Pre Production, and counted towards Planned.** It was asked only
  on an outdoor shoot and counted on neither, so a shoot with no day could read fully planned, and a
  Studio / In-House shoot - where the date was left to Edit Project - gave the coordinator who
  learns the day nowhere to put it. Both are asked it now, beside the event times, marked and
  counted: seven mandatory answers on an outdoor shoot and five on an indoor one.
  [formPanelConfig.js](../frontend/src/constants/formPanelConfig.js),
  [preProductionProgress.js](../frontend/src/lib/preProductionProgress.js)
- **Pre Production and Production mark the fields a shoot is counted Planned on.** The answers that
  decide the percentage carried no asterisk, so the only way to learn which ones were holding a
  shoot short was to fill them one at a time. Pre Production now marks Event Start Time, Event End
  Time and Reporting Time on every shoot, plus Location Address, Studio Start Date and Studio Start
  Time on an outdoor one, or Branch on an indoor one, with Shoot Date on both; Production marks Production Coordinator beside
  Travel Mode. On Pre Production the mark does not refuse the save - a shoot's details arrive over
  days - while Production asks for both before a plan is submitted, as it already did.
  [formPanelConfig.js](../frontend/src/constants/formPanelConfig.js),
  [productionFormConfig.js](../frontend/src/constants/productionFormConfig.js)
- **A camera on one shoot is no longer offered to another happening at the same time.** The Cameras
  list now leaves out any camera carried on another shoot whose time overlaps - the rule the Person
  and Assistant lists already followed for people - and the server refuses one newly named, saying
  which. It goes by time, not by day: two shoots on the same day that do not overlap can share a
  camera, and whatever this shoot already holds stays listed.
  [availability.js](../backend/src/modules/project-management/production/availability.js),
  [ProductionServiceCrew.js](../frontend/src/components/project-management/production/ProductionServiceCrew.js)

- **A service's person can now be given several cameras.** The Production plan's Camera dropdown is
  a **Cameras** multi-select, so a shooter working two bodies is one person on one service with both
  cameras against their name. The rule that a camera goes to one service of a shoot still holds
  across the whole selection, and each camera already planned carried over. A vendor in that seat is
  still asked for Waiting / Confirmed instead, and assistants take none.
  [ProductionServiceCrew.js](../frontend/src/components/project-management/production/ProductionServiceCrew.js),
  [plan.js](../backend/src/modules/project-management/production/plan.js),
  [migration](../backend/prisma/migrations/20261022120000_service_crew_cameras/migration.sql)

- **Travel Mode is marked required on the production plan.** It is mandatory beside the Production
  Coordinator and each service's person - the three parts a plan is counted on and the three the
  server asks for before a submit - but the field carried no asterisk, so the only way to learn it was
  needed was to be refused. It now shows one, and an unanswered mode refuses the save pointing at the
  Travel section. An **indoor** (Studio / In-House) shoot has no travel at all and is not marked. A
  field's `required` can now be a function of the answers and the record, read the same way by the
  panel that draws it and the check that refuses a save, as `label` and `placeholder` already were.
  [productionFormConfig.js](../frontend/src/constants/productionFormConfig.js),
  [SchemaFormFields.js](../frontend/src/components/schema-form/SchemaFormFields.js),
  [requiredProblems.js](../frontend/src/components/schema-form/requiredProblems.js).

- **A service's Person and Assistants offer every active vendor, not only the ones ticked "Can be a
  production team member".** The list showed employees plus the vendors whose record carried that
  Yes, and the server refused any other - so a vendor the studio had just hired for a shoot could not
  be put on it until somebody went and ticked their record. Every active vendor is now offered as
  "EXT - vendor name", and only an inactive vendor is refused. The tick stays on the vendor as what
  their record says about them, and anybody already on a service still shows however their record
  reads now.
  [productionPlan.mjs](../frontend/src/lib/productionPlan.mjs),
  [plan.js](../backend/src/modules/project-management/production/plan.js).

- **A plan's percentage counts only its mandatory parts, on both Production and Pre Production.** A
  shoot sat at three quarters and never reached **Planned** because a camera had not been picked or a
  dozen chased questions were untouched, so the figure said "not ready" about work that was.
  - **Production** now counts the **Production Coordinator**, an outdoor shoot's **Travel Mode** and
    each service's **Person**. The travel mode is mandatory - a plan cannot be submitted without one,
    as it cannot without a coordinator; an indoor (Studio / In-House) shoot has no travel at all. The
    **camera**, the mode's detail (plate, vehicle, ticket, the line for Other), the assistants and the
    remarks are still on the plan and none of them is counted or blocks Planned. Submitting still asks
    for the chosen mode's detail. Where a ticket stands is recorded rather than counted.
  - **Pre Production** now counts the **event start and end times**, the **reporting time**, and where
    the shoot is: the **Location Address** and **Studio Start Date / Time** for an outdoor shoot, the
    **Shoot Branch** for an indoor one. The vertical checklist, the Location Link, the accommodation
    and the concepts are not counted - they are work to do, and any of them still marks a shoot as
    started, so nothing reads Yet to Start while somebody is working it.
  [planCompleteness.js](../backend/src/modules/project-management/production/planCompleteness.js),
  [plan.js](../backend/src/modules/project-management/production/plan.js),
  [preProductionProgress.js](../frontend/src/lib/preProductionProgress.js).
- **Employee Repository → Onboarding Invites lists invites in the same table as the repository.**
  The dialog's list was its own hand-drawn table: no sorting, no filters, a fixed width, and Edit,
  Cancel Invite and Resend Invite as a run of links in a last column. It is the shared `DataTable`
  now, with the invite's columns - Candidate Name, Email, Phone, Intended Designation, Status,
  Expires At, Created At - so it sorts on any heading, filters in the row under them (typed for
  name, email and phone; picked from a list for designation and status; a calendar for the dates),
  remembers how it was arranged, and scrolls inside the card like the register beside it. The
  status is the same dot-and-word the repository's own status column draws. A candidate's earlier
  attempts open under their current invite behind the row's chevron, and the things that can still
  be done to an invite are in its ⋮ menu, exactly as on every other table; an earlier attempt and a
  submitted invite have no menu, as they offered nothing before. Nothing about what an invite is,
  who may create, correct or cancel one, or what the server does has changed.
  [OnboardingInviteTable.js](../frontend/src/components/employees/OnboardingInviteTable.js),
  [OnboardingInviteDialog.js](../frontend/src/components/employees/OnboardingInviteDialog.js)
- **Inactive Time Track now counts the time signed in, from sign-in to sign-out.** On Reports &
  Analytics → Application Usage, a day's signed-in time runs from its Login line to its Logout line
  in the User Activity Log - or, where nobody signed out, to the end of the studio day, 23:59:59 in
  Asia/Kolkata (today's runs to now). Inactive is that less the time actually used, day by day, added
  up over the range. The browser's Sign out only clears its own token and writes no Logout line, so
  most web sessions run to the end of the day; the desktop app's sign-out does write one. A day with
  no Login line - before the log existed (20 Oct 2026), past its retention, or a session carried over
  from an earlier day - keeps the previous figure: the span of that day's use, first stretch to last.
  A day somebody signed in and never used the application now appears, all of it inactive. Two
  logins under one name are still one row, the compromise the reports make everywhere, so one's
  sign-in stands for both. WhatsApp Usage keeps the span of its own use.
  [signedIn.js](../backend/src/modules/sales/crm-reports/signedIn.js),
  [crm-reports/service.js](../backend/src/modules/sales/crm-reports/service.js),
  [crmReports.js](../frontend/src/lib/crmReports.js)

- **AI Editing renders and desktop AI Culling run faster, with exactly the same results.**
  - The editing engine
    ([edit_engine.py](../backend/src/modules/image-selection/ai-editing/edit_engine.py)) works
    masked face and region steps (region blends, eye enhancement, under-eye lift) only inside the
    mask's own box, measures the skin mask once per render instead of twice, and computes the
    colour spread without numpy's slow 3-wide reduction. Every output pixel and every reported
    field is unchanged: 18 of 18 test renders across Auto, Portrait and all-tools recipes are byte
    for byte the old engine's, and the teeth pass stays on the whole frame because OpenCV's HSV
    round trip differs on a crop. Measured on 3000 px renders: Auto 3.7 s → 3.2 s, a Portrait edit
    with face tools 22.3 s → 18.3 s. Desktops fetch the new script by its digest as before.
  - Desktop app (Image-Selection_Desktop---BCT): culling on this computer reads and decodes each
    original once for both its technical numbers and the face engine's frame
    (`culling_analyze_local`), and the face frame no longer builds a thumbnail it threw away. The
    numbers posted and the frame the engine reads are identical (36 of 36 photos); 24 MP originals
    with faces go from 25 to 29 photos a minute on two workers.
  - New test
    [image-selection-ai-editing-engine-exact.test.js](../backend/test/image-selection-ai-editing-engine-exact.test.js)
    pins the engine's fast paths to the whole-frame numbers. No API, schema, permission, storage or
    configuration change.

- **Duplicate on a Shoot List now opens the shoot form with Shoot left to choose, everything else
  copied.** On Create / Edit Project, Start / Edit Project and the Quotation Generator, ⋮ → Duplicate
  opens the Duplicate Shoot dialog filled with the copied shoot's type, place, district, state, date,
  session timing and duration, food, accommodation, travel, preference and Additional Text - and an
  empty Shoot field, since a copy is nearly always the same arrangements for a different shoot. The
  copy opens as not the Main Event, so the mark stays on the original unless it is switched on for
  the copy and the move confirmed, as on Edit. Save adds it as a new shoot with its
  own ID through the same path Add Shoot uses, and the original is untouched. The Quotation
  Generator's Duplicate used to add an exact copy straight to the list with no form; it now opens
  the same dialog, and on Save still brings the original's service and deliverable lines along
  under the copy, with Undo. Cancel adds nothing. Nothing changes for Add Shoot or Edit Shoot, and
  no permission changes.
  [shootDuplicate.mjs](../frontend/src/lib/shootDuplicate.mjs),
  [AddShootDialog.js](../frontend/src/components/project-management/AddShootDialog.js),
  [QuotationGeneratorPanel.js](../frontend/src/components/sales/QuotationGeneratorPanel.js)
- **Add / Edit Shoot no longer asks for District and State.** Both were required on every screen the
  shoot dialog opens on - Create Project, Start / Edit Project, the shoot list, the Quotation
  Generator - so a shoot could not be saved until somebody typed where it was, which is often settled
  long after it is booked and was being guessed and corrected later. Both fields stay on the form,
  and picking a district still fills its state in; neither holds the save. The dialog now refuses only
  "Complete Shoot and Shoot Place.", and the server takes a shoot with neither, storing a blank as
  nothing rather than as `""`. The Quotation Generator's own exception (`districtOptional`) is gone,
  having nothing left to say. Pre Production's **import** still requires both.
  [AddShootDialog.js](../frontend/src/components/project-management/AddShootDialog.js),
  [controller.js](../backend/src/modules/sales/projects/controller.js).

- **Update status over the ticked projects offers Production's Completed and Yet to Start.** It
  offered only Planned, Hold and Rejected, so a Production project could never be marked
  **Completed** by hand (it had to be reached by every shoot finishing), and neither board could be
  put back to **Yet to Start**. Over the ticks, Pre Production now offers Yet to Start / Planned /
  Hold / Rejected and Production Yet to Start / Planned / Completed / Hold / Rejected, each beside
  Automatic; Pre Production is still done at Planned and has no Completed of its own. **A single
  project's ⋮ Update status is unchanged** - Automatic / Planned / Hold / Rejected: Yet to Start and
  Completed answer for a batch being moved together, where one project's board already says where it
  stands. Only Hold and Rejected ask for remarks. The project lands in the matching board tab, with
  that status's own colour, and in Overall Status its own stage follows it - Planned or Completed
  finishes that stage, Yet to Start says it has not started, whatever the shoots have reached. One
  board's status still never touches the other's, nor any shoot. The choices, the two that are the
  ticks' own and what each says it will do now live in `lib/departmentStatuses.mjs`.
  [departmentStatuses.mjs](../frontend/src/lib/departmentStatuses.mjs),
  [departmentStatus.js](../backend/src/modules/project-management/departmentStatus.js),
  [stage.js](../backend/src/modules/sales/projects/stage.js).

- **District is optional on a quotation's shoots.** In the Quotation Generator's Add Shoot, District
  no longer carries a `*`: a shoot can be added, saved as a draft and generated without one, and a
  District that is chosen or typed is kept as before. Booking a project from such a quotation works
  too - the server now accepts a project shoot with no district and stores it as empty. Adding a shoot
  on Create Project or a project's own plan still asks for District, and every other required field is
